question: What is the summary of the guṇa-transcendent ascetic?
premises: even in strand-conflict he remains beyond strands
inference: The summary verse gathers the guṇa-transcendent ascetic as equal and free from ego-delusion even amid strand-conflict.
uncertainties: long fused compounds are glossed as wholes
plain_english: Here is the summary verse: shining with devotion-rasa absorption and free from ego-delusion, even when strands conflict, the guṇa-transcendent ascetic remains equal.
